name: CircuitBridge Learning
mission: Make practical AI and electronics education approachable through small, guided workshops for adult learners.
audience: Adult beginners, university students, and small teams who want applied technical skills.
value_proposition: Small groups, plain-language explanations, and a tangible project in each workshop; transparent published tuition and prerequisites.

team.name: Leila Farah
team.profile: Designs beginner-friendly AI and Python lessons.

team.name: Karim Nassar
team.profile: Develops practical sensor and edge-computing exercises.

team.name: Mira Haddad
team.profile: Helps learners compare workshops and records follow-up requests.

ai_foundations.name: AI Foundations
ai_foundations.outcome: A guided no-code AI classification exercise

edge_ai_lab.name: Edge AI Lab
edge_ai_lab.delivery: In person in Beirut by arrangement

policies.group_discount: Groups of 5 to 12 learners receive 10% off published tuition. Groups larger than 12 require a separate inquiry.
policies.reschedule: One free reschedule is available with at least 48 hours of notice.
policies.quotes: Estimates cover tuition only. Tax status is not published. A quote does not reserve a place or confirm availability.
policies.availability: Dates, remaining seats, exact venue, and instructor availability are not published. The assistant cannot confirm bookings.
policies.unknowns: Refund terms, accreditation, placement statistics, tax treatment, and scholarships are not published.
policies.contact: Use the assistant to request follow-up. No working public email address is provided in this fictional exercise.
policies.privacy: The demonstration stores authorized lead details and feedback in local JSONL files. Explicit requests not to log are respected by the tools and persistent trace writer. This is a teaching prototype, without a production retention or access-control service.
